suallar.title: Frequently asked questions
suallar.helper: You'll find answers to the most common questions here.

q1.question: What is Futbolio?
q1.answer: Futbolio is a service that finds players, goalkeepers, referees and medics for amateur football games in Baku. You can order a missing player for your team, an entire opposing team, or a referee for your game, all in one place.

q2.question: How do I place an order?
q2.answer: Press the "Order" button, choose who you need, the game's time, the stadium and your price range. The details turn into a ready WhatsApp message, and our team gets in touch with you.

q3.question: Can I order just a goalkeeper?
q3.answer: Yes. You can choose just a goalkeeper, just a player, or both together.

q4.question: Can I find a whole opposing team?
q4.answer: Yes. Select "Whole opposing team" in your order and specify the team's format (e.g. 6x6).

q5.question: How much does it cost?
q5.answer: The price depends on the player's level, the game's duration, and the size of your order. You choose a price range when ordering, the exact amount is agreed with you directly.

q6.question: How are players selected?
q6.answer: Every player submits their position, experience, available times, photo and video during registration. Players matching your order's level are selected.

q7.question: How can I become a player, referee or medic on Futbolio?
q7.answer: Press the "Sign up" button, choose your role, and fill out the form. Registration is free.

q8.question: Is there an age limit for registration?
q8.answer: Yes, it depends on the role: players and goalkeepers must be 18-45, referees 18-55, and medics 18-75.

q9.question: Can I order a referee or medic too?
q9.answer: Yes. A referee, sports doctor or nurse can be ordered separately or together with players for your games.

q10.question: Can I find players for student tournaments?
q10.answer: Yes. During registration, players indicate whether they're university students, which helps us find suitable players for tournaments open only to students.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains the rules around the data Futbolio collects through its registration form. Note: this text is not legal advice and should be reviewed by a lawyer before final publication.
privacy.dataBody: We only collect the data you provide in the registration form: name, contact details, position/experience information, and (where applicable) any files you upload. ID numbers, addresses, or banking details are never requested or stored.
privacy.purposeBody: We use this data only to connect you with a suitable team or candidate.
privacy.retentionBody: Rejected or archived applications are, by default, deleted 12 months after the last activity.
privacy.sharingBody: None of this data is shared with anyone outside Futbolio.
privacy.deletionTitle: How to request deletion of your data
privacy.deletionBody: You can contact us via WhatsApp or email to request deletion of your data.

about.title: About us
about.paragraph1: Futbolio was created for people who play amateur football in Baku. It's a situation everyone knows: the game is set, the pitch is ready, but at the last minute a player doesn't show up, no goalkeeper can be found, or the opposing team doesn't turn up. We're here to solve that problem.
about.paragraph2: Futbolio brings players, goalkeepers, referees and medics together on one platform. The person ordering specifies who they need and the game's time and location, and we find people who match the level and time needed. One player, several players, or a whole opposing team, all through a single order.
about.paragraph3: Everyone who registers on our platform submits their position, experience, the times they can play, and a photo and video. This lets us pick the right person for each order.
about.paragraph4: Our goal is simple: no game should be cancelled for lack of players, and football should be easier for everyone to organize.
